mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation_budget b JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.evaluation_run_id=b.id SET b.state='STOPPED' WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.id=#{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,id,max_requests,requests_used,max_cost_micros,cost_held,state,policy_version,plan_snapshot,plan_digest,phase_b_snapshot,phase_b_digest FROM evaluation_budget WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation_budget SET state='STOPPED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{runId}
UPDATE evaluation_budget SET requests_used=requests_used+1,cost_held=cost_held+#{cost} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{runId}
UPDATE evaluation_budget SET cost_held=cost_held+#{delta},state=IF(#{stop},'STOPPED',state) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{runId}
